newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY

- China announces list of government delegation to Hong Kong handover ceremony. Jiang Zemin, general secretary of Communist Party of China and President will head the delegation, which includes Zhuo Lin, widow of Deng Xiaoping
- Chinese scientists succeeded in positioning the Fengyun 2, a meterological satellite launched on June 10, in orbit
- Mainland China to be hinterland for prosperous Hong Kong
- Frontpage article warns listed companies against falsifying accounts, issuing news to affect share price
- Commercial and industrial tax up 16.6 percent in May
BEIJING DAILY
- Municipal government issues circular to all institutions and enterprises to raise national flag on July 1 for Hong Kong handover
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
- China's power sector needs 690 billion yuan of investment in 1996-2000. Power industry has actually used $13.06 billion in foreign investment since start of reform and opening up
CHINA SECURITIES
- China issues guidelines for state enterprise reform in 1997
- Shenzhen Development Bank to hold shareholders meeting on July 22
- China natural rubber imports reach 194,904 tonnes in January-May, up 6.1 percent year-on-year
- State Information Centre says industry shows slow recovery
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Chen Yuan, vice governor of central bank, says China will support Hong Kong's currency if necessary, says Shanghai will not be international financial centre in short-term

- Ministry of Finance official says to carry out check on ex-budgetary funds from Juen to end-August, says local and departmental officials reluctant to turn over funds to higher authorities, fail to punish officials for irregularities.
- Guangxi shuts down illegal futures, stock firms
- China's service sector accounts for 38.1 percent of GDP in first quarter, up by 1.2 percentage points
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Central bank officials to receive training in United States
- Shanghai life insurance premiums hit 1.29 billion in first quarter, up 122 percent year-on-year
CHINA CHEMICAL INDUSTRY NEWS
- China's Fushun Shuangling Lubricating Oil Co sales reach 5,999 tonnes in January-May
FUTURES HERALD
- Soybean output likely to cinrease because of rise in planted acreage
FINANCIAL MORNING POST
- China bank officials urged to read book on failure of Barings
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- China second quarter fixed-asset investment seen up 17 percent
CHINA DAILY
- City residents will have to start paying a water drainage fee
